$\mathrm{So}, \mathrm{m}_{\mathrm{A}} \mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{A}} \Delta \theta_{\mathrm{A}}=\mathrm{m}_{\mathrm{B}} \mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{B}} \Delta \theta_{\mathrm{B}}$

$\begin{array}{l}

\end{array}$

$2 \times\left(\frac{3}{4}\right) \times(100-\theta)=(\theta-50)$

$\begin{array}{l}

300-3 \theta=2 \theta-100 \\

400=5 \theta \Rightarrow \theta=80^{\circ} \mathrm{C}

\end{array}$

\therefore \quad \lambda \propto \frac{1}{\left(\mathrm{v}-\mathrm{v}_{0}\right)^{1 / 2}}

\end{array}

$$
